purpose: Tabs 标签页; reference Gallery contract with the documented necessary accessibility color exception (docs/DESIGN.md).

interface.inputs: Signature authority (all public constructors, parameters, types, requiredness and defaults): [IslandTabs](../../lib/src/components/tabs.dart), [IslandTab](../../lib/src/components/tabs.dart). Only declarations exported by lib/animal_island_ui.dart are public. This contract defines behavior; it does not maintain a second parameter list. Widget/span slots are opaque and must not be inspected or rewritten.
interface.outputs: User intent callbacks; host decides whether to commit controlled state.
interface.state_model: Stable value keys own selection, focus and active-panel identity. Controlled rejection leaves content unchanged. Uncontrolled removal falls back to first remaining. Switching unmounts the old panel. Reordering a focused header reconciles only the still-current resumed view after semantic layout; explicit external focus, inactive browser and disposal cancel restoration.
interface.events: A child action dispatches once and does not activate its ancestor.
interface.composition: Parent owns placement and constraints; component owns its surface; each slot defines inherited defaults, explicit child styles win. The header shares proportional shrink across capsule content widths, preserving padding and intrinsic minima, then stretches all capsules to the tallest wrapped label. The mounted opaque label tree supplies its own intrinsic metrics and line-break choices; no child type or content is inspected or rebuilt. A pending presentation-focus recovery survives benign host/theme rebuilds while its child/header owner is unchanged. New recovery ownership supersedes the previous request; replacement, removal, disposal, inactive view and explicit external destinations retain priority. Rebuilding alone does not cancel an otherwise valid request.
interface.accessibility: Named controls, states and keyboard actions. Screen-reader execution and validation are excluded by the user scope decision on 2026-10-17; named semantics and keyboard contracts remain required. Owned secondary text uses the authorized readable semantic roles. Historical failures remain in the audit record; all-state acceptance remains separate; screen-reader validation is excluded by the current user scope.
interface.localization: Reference Chinese Gallery; host content and inherited directionality.
interface.async_behavior: Host owns business requests. Timers, routes and presentation state are disposed by their creator.
interface.lifecycle: Borrowed controllers and focus nodes are never disposed by consumers.
interface.styling: One foundation-owned product palette with component-owned state recipes; documented accessibility color differences under docs/DESIGN.md. Existing contrast thresholds remain. Explicit child styles win; no opaque-child inspection, parallel palette or Gallery-only imitation. Selected fill, owned foreground and internal focus update atomically to prevent low-contrast intermediate pairings. Transparent content follows its host theme; fixed light controls retain their paired foregrounds. This registered color-transition exception preserves geometry, shadow/rotation motion and opaque child styles. Global readable-motion authority: docs/DESIGN.md. Component-specific state and lifecycle rules remain with their owners; every transition retains the existing contrast budgets. Owned readable text roles also set default icon roles. Fixed light content surfaces scope light semantic roles for nested public controls; explicit child styles and unrelated ThemeExtensions remain unchanged.
interface.migration: Replaces draft labels/index API atomically, no adapter. Reference leafAnimation is a deprecated no-op and is shown as two identical demonstrations, not added to the new API.

scenarios.then: It requests the second item’s declared stable value; only host commit updates selection and panel semantics, independent of item index.

scenarios.given: The pinned reference page and its recorded sections
scenarios.when: Capture the same viewport and interaction state
scenarios.then: Layout, typography, geometry, assets and motion agree; necessary accessibility color differences are registered against actual states/backgrounds under docs/DESIGN.md, and other differences remain failures. User-approved readable-motion deviations follow docs/DESIGN.md with no transition exemption.
